name: Learn a skill or certification
summary: Study for a skill, exam or demo with a schedule, practice tests and built-in review days.

onboarding.prompt: What are you learning or certifying in?
onboarding.reaction: Great choice. Let's make a schedule.

onboarding.prompt: When is the exam or demo?
onboarding.reaction: Date set. Review days fill in before it.

onboarding.prompt: Do you have study materials yet?
onboarding.reaction: We'll add a gather step if needed.

phases.name: Map
actions: List exam topics or demo requirements

plan_blueprint.calendar: Study blocks on the chosen slots, a weekly review day, practice tests every two weeks, and the exam date. Phases compress for shorter timelines.

approach_variants.habit: Short daily study at the same time; streak of study days.
approach_variants.willpower: Practice-score challenges and a countdown to exam day.
approach_variants.time: Topic-by-topic calendar blocks; weekly hours review.
approach_variants.reward: Owner-chosen reward at each practice-test milestone and after the exam.
approach_variants.resource: First week gathers books, courses, practice tests and a study buddy.

guardrails: Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
Product, app or recipe ideas are labeled as suggestions; any affiliate link is disclosed.
restart_rules: A missed study block moves to the next review day. After a missed week, the plan re-spreads remaining topics up to the exam date and flags if a later date would be more realistic.
